title: CBTech launches TGV foundry production line, secures sample orders from 5 major customers
html: Precision exposure equipment maker Chime Ball Technology (CBTech) announced on November 25 that Taiwan's first full-process foundry production line for through glass via (TGV) and glass core substrates (GCS) has been completed and has begun operations at its...
summary: Chime Ball Technology (CBTech) announced that Taiwan's first full-process foundry production line for through glass via (TGV) technology and glass core substrates has been completed.
